_provenance: Seasonal-management foundation config. Created as an additive layer over drive_master.csv (read-only). Thresholds are reporting bins over continuous variables; run sensitivity with alternative boundaries. Corpus at creation: 367 warm-season drives 2026-05-11..2026-09-10, 0 cold / 45 shoulder / 322 warm. Cold + shoulder cohorts populate as future drives are ingested.

ambient._policy: Ambient is supplied MANUALLY per drive via ambientByDrive (driver-recorded, originating from the vehicle's ambient readout). This is the authoritative ambient measurement channel. The raw per-second vehicle-ambient PID is NOT used as an ambient source (sparse ~4/367, not the study's ambient channel) and is excluded from raw_temp_pass.py. A historical-weather substitution is marked explicitly via a per-drive source override when used.
ambient._legacyReader: arrays [start,end] / [start,interim,end] / scalar default to vehicle_sensor unless an explicit per-drive weather-source override exists

coldSoak._note: confirmed requires long gap + consistent continuity + observed start-thermal proximity to ambient; 6h alone is 'long parked', not 'cold soaked' (tau=17.6h -> ~29% recovery at 6h)

payload._note: nominal stratification/sensitivity only; kept separate from the modeled class-conditional VEHICLE_MASS_KG operating masses

hvacClasses.H3: substantial defrost or max heat >= 25% of drive

aggregationRules.median: recompute from pooled selected observations; never average seasonal medians
aggregationRules.dayMean: aggregate within day first, then day-weighted
aggregationRules.allPeriod: compute from all selected observations; never average warm and cold headline cards

cohorts._allYearGate: rename to 'All year' only after a complete 12-month observation window exists; a typical/reference year requires explicit exposure weights and is labelled separately
cohorts._minDrivesForStatistics: M310: a thermal cohort with fewer drives is relabelled '<regime>_insufficient' in the seasonal master (thermal_regime_raw keeps the physical class) and every cohort builder sees it as empty; matches the dashboard's minimum of 10
